status: Frozen after source-availability audit and before this experiment's fits. Exploratory development: these historical periods have previously been analyzed.
source: Annual verified ProQuest economy claims 1900–2010; existing print-time monthly panel; no LOC, old crisis-window exports, annotations or verifier prose
forecast_origin: First day of month t; newspaper observations through t-1; macro vintage availability strictly before issuance
target: Final revised INDPRO direction from t-1 to t+5, with +/-2 percent inclusive flat band
training_labels: Recompute within the latest IPT vintage available before each January refit. Both endpoints must exist in that same vintage and endpoint plus three months must be strictly before refit. Never fill missing vintage history from revised outcome data.
refit: Every January; expanding eligible training history; no within-year refit
eligibility: All selected macro and four press features must be observed for every model's common training/evaluation months. No imputations; unavailable historical inputs remain missing.
macro_transformations: IP and CPI percentage changes within a single vintage; unemployment level and percentage-point changes. Lag windows measured from each snapshot's latest observed month. Include observation age in months.

models.recent_base_rate: Laplace-smoothed class frequencies in the latest 120 eligible mature training months, or all available if fewer
models.macro_only: Multinomial ridge logistic regression on standardized vintage macro inputs
models.macro_plus_press: Same regression with the four standardized press signals added

preprocessing: StandardScaler fitted only on common eligible training months; equal month weights; no class weighting
primary_metric: Multiclass Brier score: sum over three classes, range 0–2, lower is better
calibration: Ten fixed probability bins per class and model; observed shares and counts; no recalibration on evaluation data
uncertainty: Paired calendar-year blocks anchored at each study's first evaluation year; resample fixed predictions, not refits. 95 percent percentile intervals. No multiple-testing adjustment.
stability: Calendar decades and five-year cells, excluding 2007–2009 forecast origins, and leave-one-five-year-cell-out scoring. Scoring exclusions do not remove those years from subsequent training.
limitations: Reconstructed vintage archive with conservative availability bounds; quarterly unemployment/CPI snapshots can be stale. Revised evaluation truth, selected newspaper query and unvalidated machine labels. CPI study is short and uses a different training history. This is exploratory historical evidence, not a fresh holdout.
